review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib for other Kan-complex or Kan-fibration notions. `KanComplex` is an `abbrev` for `HomotopicalAlgebra.IsFibrant`, so it is a named specialisation of the existing fibrancy concept, not a competing one. It is used by `Quasicategory/Basic.lean` and `KanComplex/MulStruct.lean`. `horn.IsCompatible.liftOfKanComplex` and `exists_lift_of_kanComplex` are thin specialisations of the generic `horn.IsCompatible.exists_lift` and `lift` in `CategoryWithFibrations.lean`. They fix the base to the terminal object and are a deliberate named API. The remaining declarations are theorems (`hornFilling`, `iff`) and an instance, which the rubric excludes. I found no independent competing definition. I did not check how the whole repository uses these declarations, so some uncertainty remains there.
